title: Credo (Palestrina, Missa Veni sponsa Christi)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Missa Veni sponsa Christi, Credo, 1599. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0019_3); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
